subject: english
stem:
Every Saturday, neighbors check on older people, carry heavy bags, and share hot meals. The visits help everyone feel connected.
What is the text mainly about?
options: Weekend visits help neighbors support one another

optionRationales.reason: People carry bags：只涵蓋一項協助。
All older people live alone：文章沒有說所有長者獨居。
Saturday is the longest day：星期六只是活動時間。
Weekend visits help neighbors support one another：多個協助行動與 connected 結果共同支持鄰里互助。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「多句以重複、同義或因果方式回到的共同概念」可推出 Weekend visits help neighbors support one another；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 Weekend visits help neighbors support one another 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
